heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~71–528×) and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B.

The pure-plays gave back more of September's bounce while the diversified ETF held up: IonQ −3.8% to $43.77, Rigetti −8.5% to $15.25, D-Wave −9.4% to $15.77, Quantinuum −7.0% to $46.08 (a fresh 52-week low) and Pasqal −13.4% to $6.05, versus the Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) +1.5% to $156.06. Concentrated single-name risk, not sector beta, drove the week.

IonQ's full-year 2026 guidance (raised Sep 17 from $280–290M) leans heavily on the SkyWater foundry acquisition (closed Jul 31). Q2 revenue was $80.05M (+287% YoY) but came with a $1.87B GAAP net loss, largely a $1.6B warrant fair-value charge. On the new guidance, forward price-to-sales is roughly 38× versus ~71× trailing.

IonQ $43.77 (~$17.39B mkt cap / $246.5M TTM revenue, P/S ~71× trailing) / Rigetti $15.25 (~$5.09B / $13.35M, P/S ~381×) / D-Wave $15.77 (~$5.87B / $12.43M, down 44% YoY, P/S ~472×) / Quantinuum $46.08 (~$12.13B / $22.97M, P/S ~528×); Pasqal $6.05 (~$1.28B mkt cap); Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) $156.06 (~$5.70B AUM), below its 52-week high of $170

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Won a $125M DARPA award (Jul 23) as one of only two companies, with Microsoft, to reach QBI Stage C (up to $300M), and finalized a $100M CHIPS R&D award on Sep 8. Valued around $10.5B privately (~$1.5B round, May 2026) and building its Moreton Bay facility in Australia.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Now public and at a 52-week low ($46.08, ~$12.1B market cap). The $100M CHIPS award and Oracle/Quanta deals have not lifted the shares; see Tier 2. Carried here for the private-to-public context.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: Previously reported 96 verified logical qubits and a DARPA QBI Stage B slot (not re-verified this week). Neutral atoms are getting more attention: Infleqtion announced 30 entangled logical qubits on Sep 24, though using error detection rather than correction.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: IonQ's $17.4B market cap sits on $246.5M of trailing revenue, and roughly half of its new FY26 guidance is inorganic (SkyWater). D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M, down 44% YoY; Quantinuum booked about $8M last quarter.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal
bear_case.description: IonQ is about 48% below its 52-week high, Rigetti's market cap is down ~47% over the year, and D-Wave trades near the bottom of a $12.75–46.75 range. Pasqal and Quantinuum both printed fresh lows this week.

bear_case.title: Dilution and government ownership
bear_case.description: Commerce is taking minority, non-controlling equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti and D-Wave, and IonQ's Q2 carried a $1.6B warrant fair-value charge that drove a $1.87B GAAP loss. Share counts and cap tables keep moving against holders.

bear_case.title: Milestones are easy to oversell
bear_case.description: Infleqtion's headline 30 logical qubits rely on distance-2 error detection with post-selection, not correction, and DOE's Genesis Q competition reportedly excludes detect-only machines. Real-time decoding like IonQ's is meaningful, but still ahead of scaled hardware.

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: PsiQuantum and Microsoft are the only firms at DARPA QBI Stage C; PsiQuantum is private. A meaningful share of the technology race sits outside the pure-play trade, or inside giants where quantum is a rounding error.

catalysts.title: IBM expands India research ties
catalysts.description: Partnerships with IIT Bombay and IISc extend IBM's quantum and AI research network; incremental rather than a step change.

catalysts.title: IonQ unveils real-time error-correction decoder
catalysts.description: Benchmarked on circuits up to 408 logical qubits and 31.5M operations with 0.02% added time; also deployments at NVIDIA's Accelerated Quantum Research Center and a South Korea partnership with SDT.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum hits a new 52-week low
catalysts.description: Shares touched $46.42 after a quarter of ~$8M revenue and a small EPS miss; the stock closed Oct 2 at $46.08.

catalysts.title: Bank of America initiates IonQ at Buy
catalysts.description: Drove a ~4% one-day gain; consensus target ~$66.63 across 14 analysts, though the stock has since given it back.

catalysts.title: Infleqtion entangles 30 logical qubits
catalysts.description: Encoded in 80 atoms on its Sqale neutral-atom machine, but via a distance-2 error-detecting code with post-selection, so it is not full error correction.

catalysts.title: Quantum World Congress
catalysts.description: D-Wave, Quantinuum and IonQ all presented; D-Wave showcased its annealing plus gate-model strategy.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Steady execution rather than fireworks: the Albany 300mm foundry plus Anderon CHIPS funding and new IIT Bombay/IISc partnerships (Oct 3); picks up the point released by Quantinuum's move to Watch.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone remains the sector's best technical result among hedged names; also a large AI-sleeve holding, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: One of only two firms in DARPA QBI Stage C and Majorana 2 is now under independent DARPA testing; the topological claims are still contested, and MSFT also sits in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: CUDA-Q and NVQLink make it the picks-and-shovels play, with IonQ now deployed at NVIDIA's Accelerated Quantum Research Center (Oct 2); quantum is immaterial to its revenue and it is also in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: Real-time decoder for up to 408 logical qubits (Oct 2) and a raised $450–460M guidance are real, but ~71× trailing sales and a $1.6B warrant charge keep it speculative at $43.77.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: $15.25 and ~381× sales with only $13.35M of TTM revenue; a $100M CHIPS award brings a government equity stake (dilution) and it is still outside DARPA QBI Stage B.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: Moved to Watch: a new 52-week low of $46.42 (Oct 1) after ~$8M of quarterly revenue and an EPS miss, at ~528× trailing sales, even though the technology is credible.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Trailing revenue of $12.43M is down 44% YoY against a ~$5.87B market cap and a $248.7M net loss; nothing this week changes the case.

positions.name: Pasqal
positions.note: Fell another 13% to $6.05, hugging its $5.90 low, on only 14% H1 revenue growth; wait for its first reported quarter as a listed company.
